description: This Java class 'FireflyProvider' implements the 'LoraProvider' interface and provides methods for extracting device ID, payload, message type, normalized data, and additional data from LoRaWAN messages specific to the 'Firefly' provider. It is annotated as a Spring component and includes configuration constants related to Firefly-specific message fields.

classes.name: FireflyProvider
classes.description: A LoRaWAN provider with API for Firefly, implementing methods to interpret and extract data from Firefly-specific LoRa messages.

methods.name: pathPrefix
methods.description: Provides the URL path prefix for the Firefly provider endpoints.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts and returns the device EUI from the provided LoRa message JSON object.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload string from the provided LoRa message JSON object.

methods.name: extractMessageType
methods.description: Determines and returns the message type, identifying uplink messages as 'UPLINK' and others as 'UNKNOWN'.

methods.name: extractNormalizedData
methods.description: Builds and returns a map of normalized data fields extracted from the LoRa message JSON, including spreading factor, function port, data rate, coding rate, frequency, frame count, and gateway information.

methods.name: extractAdditionalData
methods.description: Returns a copy of the input message with specific fields removed or null; in this implementation, it returns null.
